resources.description: Before an autonomous agent sends funds, check whether the exact EVM destination address appears in current official OFAC SDN or Consolidated data. Returns a compact stop/no-exact-match decision, freshness, and the premium evidence path; no clearance or legal advice.

Check whether a company filed a new SEC 8-K, 10-Q, or 10-K after a timestamp. Accepts a ticker or CIK and returns a compact filing decision, accession links, and a next-check cursor; no materiality opinion or investment advice.

Turn one SEC Form D accession into an agent-ready funded-company prospect dossier. Combines the official filing, reported offering facts and related people with fresh web research in one call, then returns source links, hashes, upstream settlement provenance, and a signed receipt. No account or API key.
Fetch one public HTTPS HTML, JSON, XML, or text source and return normalized agent-ready text, optional literal-match excerpts, a content hash, and an Ed25519-signed receipt. No account or API key.

Run an exact-match OFAC SDN and Consolidated identifier lookup for crypto wallets, OFAC UIDs, or exact names. Returns versioned U.S. Treasury source hashes and a signed evidence receipt; no fuzzy screening or sanctions clearance.

Detect new SEC EDGAR 8-K, 10-Q, and 10-K filings since a known accession and compute selected XBRL fact deltas. Returns official source URLs, hashes, freshness, and a signed evidence receipt; no investment advice.

Procure a current company profile from a pinned search supplier and a pinned schema-normalization supplier. One call handles upstream x402 payments, returns bounded derived fields and source links, surfaces contradictions or partial fulfillment, and signs the result.
